grammar.title: Present Continuous (am / is / are + -ing)
grammar.explanation:
Hozirgi davomli zamon hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi:
**to be (am/is/are) + fe’l + -ing**

- I **am wearing** a red shirt. — Men qizil koʻylak kiyib turibman.
- She **is reading**. — U oʻqiyapti.
- They **are playing**. — Ular oʻynayapti.

Oʻzbek tilida «oʻqi-**yap**-man» (-yap-) shakli bor — inglizchada esa am/is/are + -ing. Kiyim haqida «kiyib turibman» ma’nosi ham shu zamon bilan beriladi: I **am wearing**.

examples.sentence: I am wearing a blue shirt.
She is wearing a red dress.

rules.note: I am working, she is working.

exercises.answer: She is wearing a red dress.
exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: She + is wearing + a red dress.

comps.title: Clothes Builder
comps.passage: I am wearing a white shirt and blue jeans. My friend is wearing a red dress. Her shoes are black. My mother is wearing a green dress and brown shoes. My brother has got a yellow hat and a blue jacket. We like our new clothes very much. Today we go to the park.
comps.passageTranslated: Men oq koʻylak va koʻk jinsi kiyib turibman. Doʻstim qizil koʻylak kiygan. Uning poyabzali qora. Onam yashil koʻylak va jigarrang poyabzal kiygan. Akamda sariq shlyapa va koʻk kurtka bor. Biz yangi kiyimlarimizni juda yaxshi koʻramiz. Bugun biz parkka boramiz.

comps.title: Listening: What I Wear
comps.passage: Today I wear a blue shirt and black trousers. My shoes are white. My sister wears a red dress. Her hat is green. We like our new clothes very much. My brother has got a yellow hat and brown shoes. Today we go to the park with our friends. The weather is warm and the sky is blue.
comps.passageTranslated: Bugun men koʻk koʻylak va qora shim kiyaman. Poyabzalim oq. Singlim qizil koʻylak kiyadi. Uning shlyapasi yashil. Biz yangi kiyimlarimizni juda yaxshi koʻramiz. Akamda sariq shlyapa va jigarrang poyabzal bor. Bugun biz doʻstlarimiz bilan parkka boramiz. Havo issiq va osmon musaffo.

comps.passage: Let's review clothes! The man is wearing a black suit and a white shirt. The woman is wearing a beautiful yellow dress and silver earrings.

comps.title: Look at My Friends
comps.passage: Look at my friends. Sara is wearing a red dress and white shoes. She is holding a small bag. Omar is wearing blue jeans and a black jacket. He is not wearing a hat today. The weather is cold, so they are walking fast. Omar's shoes are old but comfortable.
comps.passageTranslated: Doʻstlarimga qarang. Sara qizil koʻylak va oq poyabzal kiygan. Qoʻlida kichik sumka bor. Umar koʻk jinsi va qora kurtka kiygan. Bugun u shlyapa kiymagan. Havo sovuq, shuning uchun ular tez yurishyapti. Umarning poyabzali eski, lekin qulay.
